title_sq: Prane Kompleksit Grand, Shitet Super Apartament 2+1+2, Ne Ndertim Te Ri!!!
description_sq: Prane Kompleksit Grand, Shitet Super Apartament 2+1+2, Ne Ndertim Te Ri!!! Prona ndodhet ne katin e 6, te nje pallati me 2 ashensore. Siperfaqja bruto e apartamentit eshte 120 m2, nga ku siperfaqja neto eshte 103 m2. Organizohet nga korridori shperndares, dhoma e ndenjes se bashku me kendin e gatimit, 2 dhoma gjumi dhe 2 tualete. title_en: Near the Grand Complex, Super Apartment 2+1+2 for sale, in a new building!!!
description_en: Near the Grand Complex, Super Apartment 2+1+2 for sale, in a new building!!! The property is located on the 6th floor of a building with 2 elevators. The gross area of ​​the apartment is 120 m2, from which the net area is 103 m2. It is organized by a distribution corridor, a living room with a kitchenette, 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. The orientation of the property is south-west. Currently, the construction is in the final stage and will be completed within this year. The area in which the property is located offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable life.
